caption:
Do you count calories? Comment YES or NO.

Counting calories helps some people and wears others out, and that's fine: in WE.LIFE, Everyday mode gives you a meal plan and shopping list, while Fit adds calories, macros, weight and workouts. WE.LIFE doesn't replace a dietitian or doctor.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Images in this video are AI-generated illustrations.
